prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1270; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the low-speed head-on collision described in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle inspection and repair records, photographs, telematics or event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any other documents or electronic data in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter within ten business days.
